literal_anchor: a man delivering harsh critical remarks while gesturing dismissively at a woman's drafted plans in front of her
selection_logic: The sentence entails three core components: the act of delivering belittling comments, the physical target of criticism ('her work'), and the affected recipient ('her'). Shot 1 serves as compact relational context where his posture and mouth convey the utterance. Shot 2 carries heavier physical evidence by tightening onto his hand roughly brushing aside her drafted model drawings. Shot 3 culminates as the dominant emotional payoff, showing her tense posture and tightly clasped hands as the derogatory words land. A fourth shot was rejected because bystander reactions or subsequent actions are wholly unsupported by the sentence text.
